concept.title: Controlling the playback
concept.shortdesc: Counter-clockwise: move to the previous file

li.p: While playing, turn the ▶▶│TRACK│◀◀ dial left/right to moves to the previous or next track.

ul.li: Clockwise: move to the next file

li.p: Counter-clockwise: move to the previous file

ul.li: You can skip files within the same folder.

li.p: While the ▶▶│TRACK│◀◀ dial is being turned and held, the file will rewind or fast forward at high speed. Once released, the file will begin playing at normal speed.

ul.li: The search function works but search speed is not constant.
While fast forwarding or rewinding, you can only hear intermittent sounds.

li.p: Press the [5 D-] or [6 D+] button to moves to the previous or next folder.

ol.li: While folder moving, he folder name will be displayed briefly.
